seatPool: Maharashtra & Minority Seats (state-level CAP; All India seats are published in a separate PDF and are NOT included)
title: Cut Off Merit for Maharashtra & Minority Seats CAP Round-I for Admission to First Year of Two Years Full Time Post Graduate Degree Course in Management viz . MBA/MMS for the Academic Year 2026-27.
publisher: State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra State, Mumbai
sourceNote: Official PDF (432 pages) listed on the MBA/MMS CAP 2026-27 portal home page under 'Seat Matrix & Cut Off' (year 2026, CAP Round 1, MH; listed 07-08-2026). The file is served by the CET Cell portal's API (mbaproject26api.4pindia.com, the backend of mba2026.mahacet.org.in); a direct GET needs browser Origin/Referer headers of mba2026.mahacet.org.in. The server filename says 2025_26 but the PDF title states Academic Year 2026-27.

fieldNotes.closingPercentile: The figure printed in brackets under each cut-off. The PDF legend says: 'Figures in bracket Indicates Merit Score'. MBA/MMS CAP merit is on a percentile basis, so the value is stored as a percentile. It is the score of the last candidate allotted in that category column in Round I. The 2025-26 Information Brochure (rules) says merit for first-year management is the "Percentile score in CET ..., CAT ... and CMAT": https://mba2025.mahacet.org.in/cetmba25/mba25/staticFiles/mba/Information_Brochure_UG&PG_2025_26.pdf
fieldNotes.closingMeritNo: The State General Merit Number of the last allotted candidate. Legend: '* Maharashtra State Seats - Cut Off Indicates State General Merit No.'
fieldNotes.categoryCode: The column code exactly as printed. Legend: G-General, L-Ladies, S-State Level Seats, PWD-Persons with Disabilities, DEF-Defence, PWDR-PWD Common Reserved Seat, DEFR-Defence Common Reserved Seat. The suffix letter is H for Home University, O for Other Than Home University, or S for State Level. EWS, TFWS (Tuition Fee Waiver), MI (Minority), ORPHAN codes (ORPNONINST/ORPINST) are used as printed.
fieldNotes.category: The caste or seat category decoded from categoryCode: OPEN, SC, ST, NTA, NTB, NTC, NTD, OBC, SEBC, EWS, TFWS, MI and so on.
fieldNotes.seatType: The section heading of the PDF block, for example 'Home University Seats - Home University Seats Allotted to Home University Candidates' or 'State Level Seats'.
fieldNotes.stage: In Round I every row is 'Stage-I'.
fieldNotes.city: Taken from the official institute name: the text after its last comma (e.g. "..., Mumbai"). It is null when the official name has no comma-separated city (56 of 397 institutes). City names were not inferred.
fieldNotes.courseCode: The CAP choice code of the course, as printed (e.g. 0300110210 - M. M. S.). One institute can have several courses (MBA, MMS, MBA specialisations).

otherOfficialFiles.note: This PDF was downloaded but not parsed. Its blocks contain several stages (Stage-I, Stage-IV, 'I-Non PWD / DEF') with sparse columns, so it needs positional parsing.
Previous-year file (407 pages), with the same format.
